data.name: Minesweeper Reloaded
data.detailed_description:
MINESWEEPER RELOADED — Tactical Mine Detection

Forget simple square-clicking. Minesweeper Reloaded takes the legendary logic game and adds depth, style, and dozens of hours of content — wrapped in a sleek retro-neon look that makes mine-hunting feel fresh again.

🏆 20+ Unique Game Modes

No other version of minesweeper gives you this many ways to play:

  • Classic – traditional minesweeper, no time limit, beat your best time

  • Time Attack – 60 seconds to clear as much as possible

  • Survival – 3 lives, keep fighting to the end

  • Zen – no pressure, earn points and use abilities

  • Campaign – 500 hand-crafted levels with star ratings

  • Endless – roguelike mode where every death means a reset. How long can you last?

  • Daily Challenge – a new puzzle every day, with bonus coins

  • Boss Arenas – 10 brutal arenas with special mechanics that test everything you know

  • Hardcore – no numbers, no flags, pure intuition and memory

  • Blitz – 15 seconds, small board, clear as many cells as possible

  • Mirror – symmetric board, every mine has a mirror copy

  • Sniper – one safe cell at a time, a solver guides you

  • Flow – a meditative, pressure-free mode on small boards

  • Race – same board for two players at once, watch your rival's progress live

  • Deminer – reversed logic, you place the mines yourself

  • Detective – guess mines purely from revealed numbers

  • Asymmetric – one player sees numbers, the other sees mines — you must communicate

  • Evolving – the board changes, a new mine every 5 seconds, adapt to survive

  • Telescope – a circular viewport that shifts with your mouse movement

  • Puzzle – 30 logic puzzles, each with exactly one solution

  • Fog of War – you only see the area around your last position

  • Versus – 2 players, 1 board, who uncovers more?

  • Custom – set your own board size and mine count

📈 Progression & Rewards

  • Daily quests for coin and XP bonuses

  • Battle Pass with 30 tiers of rewards — free and premium tracks

  • Mystery Chest with skins ranging from common to legendary

  • 116 achievements to unlock

  • Leaderboards across Classic, Time Attack, and Survival modes

  • Shareable challenge codes for friends

🎨 Style

A bold retro-neon aesthetic with a minimalist yet atmospheric design that gives the classic game a striking new visual identity.
